description: This file provides a utility function 'shapeAgentGroupedSeries' that processes raw aggregate records into a structured dataset suitable for visualization with Recharts. It groups data by agent and an optional secondary dimension ('environment' or 'cost_category'), ensuring categories are consistent across agents and filling in missing data with zeros.

methods.name: shapeAgentGroupedSeries(records, groupBy = "environment", options)
methods.description: Transforms raw records into a grouped dataset with zero-filled categories for consistent visualization, supporting options for labeling and sorting.
